title: An endpoint ledger for impressive demonstrations
hypothesis: On a frozen local model, explanation fluency will show weaker agreement with held-out task correctness than executable checks do; an agreement gap below 0.10 would favor endpoint convergence over dissociation.
experiment: Preregister 60 procedurally generated logic/programming task families and four surface variants each. Freeze prompts, decoding and model checksum. Score exact solutions, executable tests, counterfactual transfer and a fixed textual-fluency rubric separately; bootstrap families, not variants.
falsifier: A narrow interval wholly below the 0.10 disagreement-gap threshold favors coherent endpoints; large preregistered dissociation favors reporting separate competencies.

title: Cost denominators without a single understanding score
hypothesis: Two frozen local models' cost rankings will reverse across at least two preregistered denominators if one gains accuracy mainly on long tasks; stable rankings would favor denominator robustness.
experiment: Use 80 synthetic task families, balanced easy/hard and short/long. Record wall time and generated tokens for one fixed attempt per model; use measured joules only if a supported meter exists. Report four denominators and all task failures.
falsifier: Consistent rankings with narrow paired uncertainty across all four denominators weaken denominator sensitivity; reversals support a conditional efficiency conclusion.

title: Synthetic natural experiments for evidence use
hypothesis: If answers use supplied rules, random rule reversals will shift the affected answers by at least 0.60 more than matched unaffected answers; generic prompt disruption predicts similar degradation in both.
experiment: Generate 100 fictional-world families with two independent rules and known answers. Randomly reverse one rule in half the families' paired prompts; retain unaltered companion questions. Freeze model, prompt template and scoring before collection.
falsifier: Near-zero targeted contrast with comparable affected/unaffected degradation favors disruption or shallow matching; a targeted contrast above 0.60 with low placebo effect favors evidence-sensitive behavior on these tasks.

title: Can anthropomorphic framing move judgments without performance?
hypothesis: An automated judge susceptible to framing will change attributed-understanding scores by at least 0.5 on a seven-point scale across labels, while identical outputs retain identical correctness; a gap below 0.2 favors framing robustness.
experiment: Freeze 100 synthetic programming/logic outputs, balanced correct/incorrect by hidden tests. Present each output under randomized anthropomorphic, mechanical and neutral labels to a fixed local judge in isolated contexts; preregister rubric, order and thresholds.
falsifier: A narrow effect interval within ±0.2 weakens the framing hypothesis. A >0.5 shift confined to interpretive ratings supports judgment sensitivity without proving anything about genuine understanding.

title: A replication passport for changing model builds
hypothesis: For one frozen model, task-template transfer will reduce accuracy by at least 0.15 relative to same-template reruns if apparent reliability depends on presentation; a gap below 0.05 favors template robustness.
experiment: Preregister 80 synthetic task families, three equivalent templates and two fixed-seed runs. Archive model/tokenizer hashes, prompt bytes and all outcomes. Analyze same-build reproducibility and template transfer separately; any second model becomes a conceptual extension.
falsifier: A narrow transfer gap under 0.05 weakens template dependence; a gap above 0.15 despite repeatable same-template outputs favors presentation-limited reliability.

title: Replicate claim-specific audits, not whole-paper verdicts
hypothesis: A typed claim ledger will reduce invalid whole-paper refutation links by at least 30 percentage points versus an untyped summary when both process identical constructed evidence packets.
experiment: Construct 90 synthetic claim/evidence packets with author-written answer keys, balanced empirical/conceptual/normative and mixed-strength evidence. Freeze two extraction prompts; run isolated contexts twice. Include deliberately irrelevant capability successes and endpoint-mismatched follow-ups.
falsifier: A narrow improvement below 10 points or a compensating omission increase favors no useful ledger benefit; ≥30 points without omission inflation supports improved scope bookkeeping.

title: Task-family weighting versus the showcase average
hypothesis: A deliberately imbalanced showcase sample will overstate equal-family held-out accuracy by at least 0.15; balanced reporting should reduce that inflation below 0.05 when evaluated against the same known task population.
experiment: Preregister 12 synthetic task families, 20 instances each, and a sealed 10-per-family holdout. Freeze local model and scoring. Compare random showcases with an explicitly simulated curator selecting easy-family examples; audit all inclusions.
falsifier: Inflation below 0.05 even under specified imbalance favors robust aggregation; ≥0.15 inflation removed by balancing supports the proposed selection diagnostic.

title: A discovery-and-confirmation firewall for capability search
hypothesis: Selecting the best of 20 prompts on a small discovery set will produce a discovery-to-confirmation gap at least 0.10 larger than a preregistered fixed prompt under a matched total token budget.
experiment: Use 100 synthetic task families split before generation into discovery and sealed confirmation. Prespecify 20 wording variants. Allocate a fixed token budget to prompt search and confirmation; run 30 resampled family splits on a reusable fixed response matrix.
falsifier: No excess optimism plus greater held-out correct families per token favors productive prompt discovery; a large gap with no budget-adjusted gain favors selection overfitting.

title: Endpoint-preserving score translation
hypothesis: A typed scoring pipeline will reject unsupported hormone-to-subjective generalization while preserving evidence that genuinely concerns the same endpoint.
experiment: Offline pilot: generate 120 synthetic study summaries, 40 per endpoint class, with fixed known effects and measurement scales; include null-hormone/positive-subjective and concordant-effect scenarios. Compare an endpoint-typed parser and an untyped pooling parser on the identical summaries and 24 predeclared recoding perturbations. The sample unit is a synthetic study summary; each method receives the same summaries and number of scoring passes. Use only public abstract/metadata statements to define endpoint labels, not to invent original participant values.
falsifier: If the simple endpoint-stratified table matches the typed pipeline on error rate and recovery across all seeded scenarios, favor endpoint stratification alone over the proposed richer representation. If scoring changes alter conclusions even within endpoint-matched continuous analyses, investigate scale sensitivity rather than endpoint confusion.

title: Evidence-unit ledger before meta-analysis
hypothesis: Deduplicating at the sample-and-paradigm level will prevent confidence gains caused solely by counting alternate reports as independent evidence.
experiment: Construct 60 synthetic base experiments in three paradigm groups, then produce 180 report records with disclosed sample overlap, alternate outcomes and mixed paradigm labels. Create two conditions with identical report counts: true independent samples and duplicated samples. Compare ledger-aware and report-level summaries with the same fixed effect estimator. The unit for uncertainty is the base experiment; allocate the same 180-record parsing budget and estimator calls to both pipelines. Public BEM follow-ups determine the ledger fields, not simulated effect magnitudes.
falsifier: If paper-ID deduplication gives calibrated coverage and correct paradigm scope under the same overlap patterns, favor the simpler ledger. If interval failure persists after exact sample deduplication, correlated outcomes or estimator assumptions are the stronger explanation.

title: Time-arrow controls for retroactive-claim pipelines
hypothesis: A time-index validator plus placebo-event contrasts will detect planted look-ahead artifacts with fewer false retroactive flags than an effect-only analysis.
experiment: Simulate 200 independent sessions per seed with observed recall fixed before a later randomized practice event. Across 100 seeds each, test null streams, an injected retroactive signal, index drift, and leakage during record selection. Compare equal-budget pipelines with 20 contrasts per seed: validation/placebos versus 20 ordinary resamples. The session is the independent unit. The injected signal is a software positive control, not a physical model or empirical evidence that retrocausation occurs.
falsifier: If clean-null and clean-injected-signal streams are flagged equally often as leaked streams, the temporal controls lack discrimination. If ordinary resampling detects all planted artifacts at matched false-positive rate, favor that simpler pipeline.

title: Separate posture totals from post-treatment pathways
hypothesis: An adjustment checker tied to an explicit total-effect estimand will avoid mediator and collider bias more reliably than a rule that adjusts for every measured correlate.
experiment: Generate 1,000 synthetic randomized two-arm datasets of 240 independent participant records, using four predeclared DAGs: pure null, subjective-only pathway, mediated endocrine pathway and post-treatment collider. Fit three fixed models per dataset with identical records and compute budgets: unadjusted assignment contrast, all-covariate adjustment, and estimand-approved adjustment. Sample sizes and pathways are illustrative, not reconstructed original power-posing data. Evaluate hormone and subjective outcomes separately.
falsifier: If unadjusted contrasts match the checker across every randomized scenario, favor the simpler unadjusted analysis for total effects. If the checker fails under an omitted mediator-outcome confounder, favor an explicitly unidentified pathway conclusion over a mediation claim.

title: Replication passports with version-sensitive scope
hypothesis: A locked passport taxonomy will reduce both false direct-replication labels and post-hoc exemption of unfavorable results.
experiment: Prepare 80 synthetic protocol pairs varying one predeclared field at a time: recall paradigm, event order, outcome, randomization, software timing or unavailable implementation version. A rule-based classifier sees only protocol differences; a result-aware baseline additionally sees a randomly assigned favorable/unfavorable label. The unit is a protocol pair; both use the same 80 pairs and one classification pass. Ground field definitions in the primary BEM and Sparks disclosures; do not invent details of inaccessible protocols.
falsifier: If endpoint-only matching achieves the same scope classification and outcome-label invariance, favor the simpler rule. If reasonable rubric choices materially reverse labels, report unresolved procedural equivalence rather than claim the passport resolves replication.

title: Crossed measurement-and-context replication atlas
hypothesis: A balanced context-by-measurement atlas will distinguish measurement artifacts from context heterogeneity more accurately than a collection where each site uses its own instrument.
experiment: Generate 12 synthetic sites with 80 independent participant records each, three endpoint channels and two alternate measurement mappings per record. In separate known scenarios plant only measurement bias, only context moderation, both or neither. Compare crossed and confounded allocations at 960 participant records and the same 1,920 measurement evaluations per endpoint. Repeat 200 seeds. Synthetic paired measurements are explicitly constructed; no claim is made that real hormone and self-report measures share a latent scale.
falsifier: If the crossed allocation cannot distinguish measurement-only from context-only scenarios above the predeclared chance baseline, favor non-identifiability. If a single harmonized instrument performs equally well under matched budgets, prefer harmonization over the more complex atlas.

title: Selection stress maps with locked evidence units
hypothesis: A locked multiverse will correctly localize whether a synthetic pooled effect changes because of weighting, missing null studies or outcome selection.
experiment: Simulate 100 base experiments in four distinct paradigm strata, then expose report collections under four known selection mechanisms. Evaluate a fixed 3-by-3-by-3 grid of weighting, admissible-inclusion and outcome rules, always showing stratum-specific results before any pooled value. Use 200 seeded corpora per mechanism; the unit is the base experiment. Give every pipeline exactly 27 estimations per corpus and identical visible records. Withheld studies are known only to the scoring harness.
falsifier: If random specifications localize the planted selection source as well as the structured grid, favor the simpler search. If all admissible choices remain biased under hidden missingness, favor an unidentified missing-evidence conclusion rather than interpreting stability as validity.

title: A discovery-to-confirmation firewall for persuasive examples
hypothesis: A discovery/confirmation firewall will reduce winner's-curse inflation while retaining more true signals than merely demanding a stricter threshold on selected discovery results.
experiment: Generate 300 synthetic research campaigns, each with 30 candidate contrasts distributed across hormone, risk and subjective endpoint families. Discovery and confirmation each receive 120 independent synthetic records per campaign. Allocate a fixed 60 contrast evaluations: 30 discovery plus 30 locked confirmation. Compare with 60 discovery-only evaluations using a predeclared adjusted threshold. Include null, sparse-signal and endpoint-specific-signal scenarios; no original participants or model outputs enter the simulation.
falsifier: If the multiplicity-adjusted discovery-only method matches confirmation error and exceeds true-signal recovery at the same budget, favor that alternative. If the firewall fails when confirmation shares hidden batch effects, favor an independently generated confirmation dataset over administrative separation alone.

title: Separate employment endpoints before comparing minimum-wage results
hypothesis: When artificial datasets encode identical hours but different full-time/part-time composition, a shared endpoint ledger reduces false declarations of contradictory employment effects relative to a single-label employment comparison.
experiment: Offline, preregister 40 synthetic state-pair policy episodes with 80 establishments each. Independently vary staffing composition, hours, survival and survey error; retain known truth for every endpoint. Create survey, payroll and administrative-like extracts with explicit overlap. Compare a ledger workflow against a one-endpoint-label workflow with equal 24-analysis budgets and identical records. Score recovery by endpoint and aggregate uncertainty over policy episodes, not establishments as independent policy assignments.
falsifier: If disagreements and error rates persist after exact endpoint and sample alignment, measurement mismatch is insufficient. If the ledger induces extra exclusions or no lower wrong-sign rate, prefer the simpler common-endpoint workflow.

title: Stress-test apparent debt thresholds against binning artifacts
hypothesis: Under smooth synthetic debt-growth relationships and unequal country histories, prespecified neighboring-bin contrasts produce more false threshold declarations than held-out change-point tests calibrated to the same false-positive budget.
experiment: Generate 60 synthetic country panels with 25 years each under three worlds: no relation, smooth negative association and true change point. Vary unequal observation lengths and serial dependence independently. Freeze 12 binned/smooth/change-point procedures before revealing world labels; give each equal training observations and held-out-country folds. Repeat 100 seeds and bootstrap entire countries. Include the original-style debt bins as one documented descriptive procedure, not an assumed ground truth.
falsifier: If matched-budget binned contrasts control false positives and locate genuine breaks as well as alternatives, the proposed stress test adds little. A stable break favoring the change-point world would count against a pure binning-artifact explanation.

title: Use time-direction placebos to expose debt-growth identification limits
hypothesis: Adding prespecified time-direction placebos and an explicit underidentified verdict reduces confident wrong-direction claims relative to contemporaneous association alone, without claiming that passing placebos proves causation.
experiment: Generate 90 synthetic 50-country, 30-year panels divided equally among debt-to-growth, growth-to-debt and latent-crisis-common-cause worlds. Include serial dependence and overlapping observable summaries; reserve world labels. Compare an association-only classifier and a graph-plus-placebo workflow with the same 10 fits per panel. Hold out whole countries and whole synthetic worlds; calibrate uncertainty by country. Permit both workflows to abstain under an identical stated loss function.
falsifier: If time placebos pass equally in confounded and causal worlds and the workflow still overclaims, they do not discriminate the hypotheses. If baseline abstention achieves equal calibration and accuracy, prefer that simpler procedure.

title: Separate wage estimands, identification assumptions and policy values
hypothesis: A graph-and-claim ledger reduces unsupported causal extrapolation across synthetic policy episodes relative to an estimate-only report, while retaining causal claims when the explicitly simulated identification assumptions hold.
experiment: Create 60 synthetic two-state policy episodes, each with 24 pre/post periods and 100 establishments per state. Factorially vary differential pretrends, cross-border spillovers and a latent demand shock; disclose only observed variables. Freeze both reporting workflows and give them six fits per episode. Blind held-out episode labels and score causal estimates and causal/associational/underidentified labels separately. Cluster assessment at policy episode; treat establishments as repeated observations.
falsifier: If the ledger merely suppresses every causal conclusion or fails to flag confounded episodes, it has not improved identification. If estimates remain calibrated under simulated spillovers, the simpler workflow is favored for that world.

title: Keep debt spreadsheet reconstruction separate from causal replication
hypothesis: Layer-specific manifests detect more injected reconstruction errors and fewer false causal-validation claims than a single pass/fail replication badge under equal audit time.
experiment: Build 24 synthetic country-year spreadsheets with 30 countries and unequal 10–40-year histories. Inject one known defect per clone: off-by-one range, omitted country, changed year inclusion or equal-country versus equal-observation weighting. Publish exact checksums and expected descriptive outputs before a blinded audit. Compare layered and pass/fail reports with 20 checks each and matched input data. Score by independent workbook and aggregate country-level contribution diagnostics within each workbook.
falsifier: If layered labels do not improve localization or increase confusion between valid alternative estimands and coding defects, retain the simpler badge plus explicit scope statement. Matching values in a confounded world must never count as causal success.

title: Version-lock the wage episode before testing transport to new settings
hypothesis: A three-tier exact-rerun, measurement-check and episode-transport contract reduces category errors relative to a flat replicated/not-replicated label without masking genuine implementation failures.
experiment: Generate 12 synthetic policy-episode families, each with one frozen original panel, a same-population alternate measurement, a changed-policy-context panel and an intentionally defective code rerun. Include both homogeneous and heterogeneous treatment-effect worlds. Assign equal 16-check budgets to flat-label and tiered workflows; hide defect/context labels until scoring. Evaluate by held-out episode family and use episode-family uncertainty, not establishment counts.
falsifier: If flat labels recover the distinctions equally well, tiering adds bureaucracy without value. If the tiered workflow excuses injected code failures as contextual variation, it fails the proposed mechanism.

title: Audit country-history selection before interpreting debt bins
hypothesis: Country-history flow diagrams plus contribution bounds identify selection-induced reversals more reliably than a final-sample summary when missingness depends on observed country histories, but offer weaker discrimination under latent-crisis missingness.
experiment: Generate 100 synthetic 40-country panels with 40 years each. Impose random missingness, observed-history-dependent truncation and unobserved-crisis-dependent suppression at matched missing fractions. Compare final-sample analysis with a prespecified flow/contribution audit using equal 12 recomputations. Include both zero and negative full-panel associations. Draw held-out entire country histories and estimate uncertainty by country blocks; report each missingness world separately.
falsifier: If the audit flags all incomplete panels indiscriminately or misses observed-selection reversals, its ledger has not discriminated the alternatives. Stable negative associations under all declared inclusions favor a robust descriptive association, still without identifying causality.

title: Distinguish wage sample attrition from endpoint selection
hypothesis: A frame-by-endpoint audit reduces erroneous reconciliation of opposing estimates relative to a pooled narrative when synthetic disagreement is deliberately caused by sample selection, endpoint selection or true effect heterogeneity.
experiment: Generate 72 synthetic policy episodes, each with 200 establishments and known employment hours, headcount and survival. Independently vary response attrition, payroll availability and size-dependent treatment effects; include an unobserved manager-shock attrition world. Give both workflows the same 3 frames × 3 endpoints and exactly 9 estimator runs. Compare a preregistered full matrix with a pooled-summary workflow. Hold out complete policy episodes; calculate performance across episodes, not within-store observations as policy replicates.
falsifier: If disagreements persist within exactly matched frames and endpoints, sample/endpoint selection is insufficient and heterogeneity or bias remains plausible. If the full matrix does not improve blinded attribution or loses coverage through multiplicity, prefer the simpler report.

title: Four resource denominators, with unstable rankings left unresolved
hypothesis: If task-mix weighting matters, request-weighted and equal-family costs will reverse model ranking with paired intervals excluding a tie; stable orders favor robust rankings and overlapping intervals remain inconclusive.
experiment: Freeze two local models/tokenizers, hardware/runtime, decoding, formal-answer format, character caps and hidden tests. Use 80 synthetic families with prespecified 2/4/8 requests each, balanced difficulty/length strata, and three paired timing repetitions. Counterbalance execution order. Amortize fixed warm-up/loading costs over a declared deployment batch; prompt-search budget is zero. Report cached/uncached policies separately.
falsifier: Stable order with narrow intervals across all four denominators weakens mix sensitivity. Opposite orders excluding ties favor denominator dependence, not universal superiority. Near ties, nonfinite ratios or low accuracy leave ranking unresolved; report the accuracy/time frontier.

title: A randomized rule intervention with one paired estimand
hypothesis: Rule-specific updating predicts a positive affected-minus-unaffected contrast above a locked threshold; generic disruption predicts comparable changes in both question types or lost baseline correctness.
experiment: Create a disjoint 20-family pilot and 100-family confirmation set, each with two independent fictional rules and binary questions. Collect original, one-rule-flipped and length-matched sham conditions, asking both questions; randomize order and flipped rule. Freeze vocabulary/templates before confirmation. Keep generator seeds, solver keys and answer strings outside prompts; supply premises and questions only.
falsifier: Before confirmation lock δ=min(0.30,max(0.10,0.5×pilot original accuracy)), excluding pilot families. Prospectively simulate precision for Δ=0,δ,0.60; retain 100 families if feasible, otherwise declare inadequate precision. Interval above δ with stable companions favors updating; near zero with equal degradation favors disruption. Low baseline accuracy, ceiling limits or intervals spanning explanations remain unresolved.

title: Template robustness with a replication passport
hypothesis: Presentation-sensitive competence predicts alternate-template accuracy at least 0.15 below reference; simultaneous paired intervals within ±0.05 for both alternates favor local template equivalence.
experiment: Use 80 latent synthetic problems, three templates and four prespecified stochastic seeds per template. Before calls validate identical logical content and target answers using canonical representations and a symbolic solver. Seal keys/seeds outside prompts. Archive model/tokenizer hashes, prompt bytes, runtime/container, accelerator/kernel and decoding settings.
falsifier: Gap below −0.15 favors presentation-limited performance; both intervals inside ±0.05 favor local equivalence. Intermediate gaps, wide intervals or validation failures are unresolved. Nondeterministic kernels change passport status, not competence interpretation.

title: When balancing fixes showcase selection—and when it cannot
hypothesis: Equal-family weighting should remove family-mix inflation under random within-family sampling, but may fail under within-family easy-item selection; unchanged gaps favor limited benefit from balancing.
experiment: Prespecify 12 synthetic families, with 20 pool and 10 sealed reference instances each, two decoding seeds per instance. Freeze model, format and caps. A disjoint pilot fixes family/item ease predictors without confirmation answers. Simulate 36-item showcases with softmax strengths β=0,1,3: family-biased, within-family-biased and balanced-but-within-family-biased selection. Reuse identical outputs for all summaries.
falsifier: Family-only bias attenuated by weighting while within-family bias persists supports the boundary. Persistent family-only bias weakens that account; small gaps across β favor population-specific robustness. Missing support, seed disagreement or wide intervals remain unresolved.

title: Overlap-aware evidence ledger with explicit abstention
hypothesis: Overlap-aware uncertainty will improve synthetic interval coverage beyond paper-ID deduplication when reports share participants across paradigms.
experiment: Predeclare 500 seeds of 60 base samples yielding 180 reports in three paradigms: independent samples, exact duplicates, partial cross-paradigm overlap and correlated outcomes. Reveal the same report summaries and global hashed participant-set metadata to every method; hide generation parameters. Strip selected overlap metadata in a separate condition. Within each endpoint, equally weight base-sample summaries after removing exact report duplicates; bootstrap graph components 1,000 times for 95% intervals. Components spanning paradigms remain one cluster. With fewer than 20 components, refuse calibrated intervals. For missing edges, enumerate a fixed ten admissible overlap graphs and display the union of their intervals, explicitly conditional on this graph set. No cross-paradigm pooled effect is required.
falsifier: If exact-sample deduplication matches coverage and precision, prefer it. If conditional graph envelopes miss truth when the true graph is excluded, label that metadata case unresolved rather than claim robust coverage.

title: Adjustment audit against ordinary randomized-trial practice
hypothesis: The checker may prevent interpretation errors beyond an ordinary trial analysis; added estimation accuracy is not presumed.
experiment: Freeze equations before sampling: A~Bernoulli(.5), X,U,e independent standard normal; M=aA+bX+U; H=tA+dM+cX+e. Null: a=t=d=0; subjective-only: a=.4,t=d=0; mediated: a=.4,d=.4,t=0. Collider case replaces M by .4A+U and H by cX+U+e. Report M and H separately; risk outcomes are outside this pilot. Across 1,000 datasets of 240 records per case, expose identical A,X,M,H tables and declared metadata; the checker never sees equations or hidden case IDs. Test correct, wrong and unknown metadata separately. Fit unadjusted H~A, baseline-adjusted H~A+X and indiscriminate H~A+X+M once per dataset; repeat for M. The checker selects among these cached fits or abstains: only verified pre-assignment covariates enter total-effect adjustment; unknown roles fall back to unadjusted estimates. Mediation remains unidentified without extra assumptions.
falsifier: If baseline-X practice matches error prevention and precision, prefer it. Wrong metadata that causes false pathway identification counts as failure; observational equivalence requires an unresolved pathway verdict, never automatic causal classification.

title: A crossed replication atlas with identifiable relative components
hypothesis: Crossing independent measurements will distinguish relative instrument bias from site moderation more reliably than confounding site and instrument.
experiment: For each endpoint separately generate Z=b_s+alpha_m+(tau+u_s+v_m+w_sm)A+epsilon, with independent participant noise and sum-to-zero u,v,w. Use 12 sites, 80 distinct participants per site, 20 in each treatment-by-instrument cell: 960 records and 960 genuinely independent measurements per endpoint. Predeclare site-only, instrument-only, both, neither and interaction stress scenarios; 200 seeds each. Fit site random intercept/slope plus fixed instrument and treatment interaction; use 1,000 whole-site bootstrap draws. Reserve four sites before tuning, retaining eight for fitting. Freeze contrasts and practical thresholds on a separate synthetic tuning seed set. Common absolute instrument bias is not identified; only relative components are estimands.
falsifier: If harmonization matches prediction and coverage, prefer it. If crossed intervals cannot localize components with eight training sites, report insufficient information. Large w_sm or equivalent models require unresolved localization, not a forced causal label.

title: Locked confirmation with matched estimators and batch stress tests
hypothesis: Held-out confirmation may reduce selected-effect inflation; any gain must survive budget matching and be reported alongside power costs.
experiment: Predeclare 300 campaigns per null, sparse and endpoint-specific signal scenario. Each has 30 synthetic standardized contrasts, ten per endpoint family, and 240 independent records split 120/120; every policy receives the same generated records. Freeze two-sided z tests with known unit variance and a family of all 30 contrasts. Split policy ranks first-half |z|, locks top three, then confirms each only if second-half p<=.05/3 with matching sign; effect estimate uses second half alone. Full-data comparator tests all 30 by Holm(.05) and reports the three largest-|z| estimates, clearly distinguishing selected from confirmed. Both compute all 30 contrasts on each half: exactly 60 evaluations; pooled sufficient statistics cost no extra contrast evaluations. Secondary comparison fixes the split-selected three and contrasts their 120-record held-out estimates with 120-record discovery estimates, isolating selection from sample size.
falsifier: If full-data Holm matches error control and improves recovery, prefer it. If reduced inflation vanishes at matched estimator sample size, credit precision/selection tradeoffs rather than the ledger. Shared-batch failure means confirmation is unresolved, not independently validated.

title: Compare wage endpoints against a strong units-and-frame baseline
hypothesis: At equal information and analysis budgets, typed compatibility checks reduce false contradiction labels on incomparable endpoint/frame pairs while retaining genuine disagreement for aligned estimands; a competent plain table may perform equally well.
experiment: Preregister 40 synthetic state-pair episodes with 80 initial establishments per state, arranged in 10 independent global-shock regimes of four dependent episodes. Define headcount as all workers, weekly hours as total paid hours, FTE as hours/40 and survival as an open indicator. For initial-population means, closed establishments contribute zero to all four numerators and remain in the denominator; survivor means are separate estimands. Nonresponse remains missing, never zero. Generate survey/payroll/administrative-like extracts with overlap, composition shifts and systematic errors. Freeze exactly 24 analyses: 3 sources × 4 endpoints × 2 frames. Both workflows see identical records, formulas, units, frame notes and missingness flags. Lock pair comparisons and reporting rules before held-out simulation seeds. For each episode define truth as the full synthetic population descriptive difference in changes, not an identified causal effect. Use 2,000 regime-block bootstrap draws for uncertainty across episode contrasts; assess small-regime interval calibration by repeated simulated regimes.
falsifier: If the typed ledger does not outperform the competent table on false contradictions while maintaining aligned-disagreement sensitivity, the simpler table is favored. Persistent disagreements after exact alignment count against endpoint mismatch as a sufficient explanation, without selecting a winner among the wage papers.

title: Benchmark causal abstention on exactly indistinguishable debt-growth worlds
hypothesis: Temporal placebos may reduce confidently wrong causal-direction declarations on distinguishable synthetic worlds; they must not create direction information in observationally equivalent or mixed-feedback worlds. Appropriate underidentification is a successful result, not an error.
experiment: Publish structural families and observable columns: country, year, measured debt D and growth G only. Families include G_t=beta D_(t-1)+aG_(t-1)+u_t; D_t=gamma G_(t-1)+bD_(t-1)+v_t; both equations jointly; and latent persistent H_t entering both, with shared global shock Z_t. Generate 90 training and 90 held-out 50-country, 30-year panels using disjoint parameter regimes and shock processes. Add exact-equivalence fixtures by generating standardized correlated Gaussian observed arrays once and pairing them with forward and reverse structural factorizations having the identical observable distribution; hide construction labels. Both workflows fit the same four prespecified families with 10 fixed diagnostic operations. Freeze pseudocode: retain any family not rejected at a training-calibrated threshold; report a direction only when every retained family implies it, otherwise underidentified; empty retained sets mean model-misspecified/unresolved. The temporal workflow allocates diagnostics to time shifts/leads, the baseline to standard residual/serial-fit checks; publish both fixed menus before holdout. Calibrate only on training panels. Resample independent full panels for aggregate error intervals; within panels block both countries and whole global-shock trajectories, never treat country-years as independent.
falsifier: If temporal diagnostics pass in confounded worlds without preserving underidentification, their causal-discrimination claim fails. Any direction declaration on exactly identical forward/reverse fixtures is overclaiming. If the baseline matches calibration and useful identification coverage, its simpler diagnostic menu is favored. Zero identification everywhere does not establish improvement.

title: Test replication manifests against a competent spreadsheet audit
hypothesis: Layered manifests may improve defect localization and scope reporting beyond a standard spreadsheet audit under equal operations, without misclassifying legitimate weighting variants as bugs or matching corrected aggregates as causal identification.
experiment: Generate 24 independent parent workbooks with 30 country histories and unequal 10–40-year observations. Create four blinded variants per parent: clean, one injected range/inclusion defect, interacting defects and an explicitly declared valid weighting variant. Shuffle labels and hide mutation maps and numerical expected values; give both auditors the same raw synthetic country-year data, formulas, declared aggregation specification and hashes. Publish hidden-score commitments before auditing and reveal reference outputs only afterward. Freeze 20 operations per workbook from the same menu: range-boundary scan, raw-to-cell reconciliation, inclusion-list comparison, weight-sum check, manual recomputation and scope-statement check. Both auditors use identical executed checks; compare a standard formula-audit report with scope notes against a layer-organized report. All variants of a parent remain in one train/test split. Estimate differences and intervals over independent parent workbooks, never treating 96 variants or country-years as independent audit replications.
falsifier: If the standard audit matches localization and numerical reconstruction with equal checks, layering has no demonstrated advantage. If layered reporting labels legitimate variants as bugs or treats matched numbers as causal confirmation, its mechanism fails. Defect recovery cannot establish the real debt-growth causal threshold.

title: Preserve unresolved selection explanations in wage reporting matrices
hypothesis: With identical results and permissible labels, a structured matrix may reduce false attribution and false reconciliation relative to a complete narrative. It must preserve unresolved observationally equivalent mixtures, not gain credit merely for printing more labels.
experiment: Generate 72 independent synthetic policy episodes, each with 200 initial establishments and pre/post measurements of headcount, paid hours and open status. Closure means zero population headcount/hours and open=0; nonresponse is missing, not closure. Define frames as survey-responding, payroll-available and administrative-covered; each frame is fixed by pre-policy membership where observable. Frame-specific descriptive contrasts target that fixed cohort including observed closures; full initial-population contrasts are separate truth values, not assumed identifiable from responding frames. Freeze nine analyses: 3 frames × 3 endpoints. Include isolated observed-selection, endpoint-definition and size-heterogeneity worlds plus mixed latent-manager-shock worlds. Construct paired latent worlds with identical released observations/masks but different unobserved nonrespondent outcomes, so population attribution is genuinely unresolved. Both reporting algorithms receive all nine estimates, definitions and masks; freeze training-tuned rules before holding out complete episode families. Use 2,000 whole-episode bootstrap draws for aggregate report-error rates. Within-episode joint intervals for nine frame contrasts use prespecified cluster max-t simulation calibrated on independent episode-family draws; report failures under global shocks separately, not as guaranteed nominal coverage.
falsifier: If structured reporting assigns a unique source in observationally equivalent mixtures, it fails. Persistent within-frame, within-endpoint disagreement counts against sample/endpoint mismatch alone. If the complete narrative preserves disagreement and calibration equally well, the matrix has no demonstrated advantage. Apparent source attribution without identification is not success.
